name: 通園支援事業者に性暴力防止措置を義務付け
summary: 市の条例に、児童対象性暴力等の防止と、起きた場合に利用乳幼児を保護するための規定を加えます。2026年12月25日から、事業者は対象業務に従事する人の犯罪事実確認など、必要な措置を講じることになります。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等の防止と発生時の乳幼児の保護に必要な措置を事業者に義務付ける
利用乳幼児と接する対象業務の従事者について犯罪事実確認などを行う
who: 乳児等通園支援事業者
利用乳幼児と接する対象業務の従事者
why: 基準の改正に伴い、児童対象性暴力等を防ぐため、従事者の犯罪事実確認などを義務付けるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Requires childcare support providers to prevent sexual violence against children and protect children if it occurs
en.official: On the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Kawasaki City Ordinance on Standards for the Facilities and Operation of the Infant and Other Childcare Support Program
en.summary: The city will add provisions to its ordinance on preventing sexual violence against children and similar acts, and protecting infants and young children using the service if such acts occur. From December 25, 2026, providers will be required to take necessary measures, including checking the criminal records of people engaged in covered work.
changes: Require providers to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, and to protect infants and young children if such acts occur
Check criminal records and similar information for workers in covered roles who come into contact with infants and young children using the service
who: Providers of the infant and other childcare support program
Infants and young children using the service and their guardians
Workers in covered roles who come into contact with infants and young children using the service
en.why: The city says the standards have been revised, and that criminal-record checks and similar measures are being made mandatory to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts.
